text:
sam: Heads-up — new tenant (acct 987654321012) onboarding next week, they need GPU capacity in ap-northeast-3. Requesting p5 and g5 instances. Current EC2 GPU quotas in that region are 0. Can infra kick off quota increases?
maria: Got it. Which exact instance families/sizes do they need and how many sustained nodes?
sam: Primary: p5 (up to 8 instances to start), fallback g5 (12) for burst. Pilot start date 2027-05-04, steady-state maybe 4 p5s. Use-case is low-latency model serving (production).
irving: Do we also need to raise ENI / VPC IP limits? p5s attach multiple ENIs. Any NAT/GW constraints?
sam: Good call — they'll want 8 ENIs per instance estimate, plus 50 elastic IPs for their testing subnet. Also requesting raising "Running On-Demand Standard (A, C, D, H, I, M, R, T, Z) instances" quota for the account in ap-northeast-3 to cover on-demand fallback.
maria: Please open AWS limit increases for these quotas: p5 (specify family quota code), g5 family, ENI quota (L-xxxx), Elastic IPs. Include account ID and justification (prod inference, 99.9% latency SLO). I'll paste the template.
anna: Template: 
```
Hi AWS Support,\nAccount: 987654321012\nRegion: ap-northeast-3 (Asia Pacific - Osaka)\nQuotas to increase:\n - EC2 GPU instance quota: p5 family -> from 0 to 8\n - EC2 GPU instance quota: g5 family -> from 0 to 12\n - Network interfaces per region (ENI) -> +100\n - Elastic IP addresses -> +50\nUse case: production LLM inference (low latency). Expected sustained usage: 4 p5 instances, peak 8. Please expedite — pilot starts 2027-05-04.\nThanks, Infra team (Redwood Inference)\n```
irving: Nice. Also add a note about burstable capacity fallback (we can route to eu-west-3 if approval delayed). AWS sometimes asks for proof of purchase or architecture diagrams — include an ARN for our Trusted Advisor/Account rep if available.
sam: I already tried console request for p5 and it failed with "Not available for this region" error. AWS support suggested opening a case under Service Quotas with account justification.
maria: I'll open the Service Quotas case now and CC infra-bot. Can someone confirm billing contact and account owner?
anna: Billing: billing@redwood.ai, Account owner: sam.
maria: Created case #2027-APN-8731 with Service Quotas. Included the template, account ID, and a short architecture note. Tagging @infra-bot to watch for status updates. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: Case created: 2027-APN-8731. Current status: Pending — awaiting AWS review. ETA: 72 hours typical.
irving: Also, let's pre-provision AMI and a launch template in ap-northeast-3 so once quotas are approved we can spin up quickly. Sam, can your tenant ops share the AMI id and required subnet IDs?
sam: Will share AMI (ami-0a1b2c3d4e5f6) and subnets by EOD.
maria: If AWS pushes back, fallback plan: 1) Use eu-west-3 (p5 available) and cross-region replication, 2) Use quantized model on fewer g5s as stopgap. Which would cost less? We'll run quick cost calc.
irving: Quick math: p5 per-hour x8 vs g5 x12 + cross-region egress. I'll run numbers and post later.
anna: FYI — we should request placement group / capacity reservation guidance from AWS for when they approve to avoid startup throttling.
sam: Appreciate it. Please ping me once approved so we can schedule provisioning and alert the tenant.
infra-bot: Case 2027-APN-8731 status changed: In Progress (AWS assigned).
maria: AWS asked for daily/peak token throughput estimate and max concurrent requests per instance. Sam, can you provide those ASAP?
sam: Tentative: 1500 tokens/sec sustained across cluster; peak 5000 tokens/sec. Concurrent requests ~ 600.
irving: Added those details to the case. Also requested a service limit lift for EBS GP3 throughput in region (we need 4K IOPS per instance).
maria: Marking this thread so we can close after quota approval. Thanks team. :pray:
sam: Thanks — will update if tenant changes timeline.
